Subject: Signed SOW & next steps

Hi Mateo —

Quick note to confirm the SOW is signed (attached) and our legal team closed yesterday. We want to target a pilot that covers 3 clinical teams (approx 15 users) with the production rollout in Q3.

High level asks from our side:
- Kickoff workshop to align on success metrics and acceptance criteria
- Network and security intake so we can get your staging allowed on our side
- Short run of model outputs evaluated against our clinical prompts during pilot

I can be the day-to-day contact: Ari Thompson, Product Lead (ari@tidewell.com). My security lead is cc'd on this thread.

Attached: Tidewell_Signed_SOW_062026.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Ari
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Signed SOW & next steps — Tidewell kickoff orchestration

Ari — great news, congrats on the sign. Welcome aboard.

Looping in Marissa (CS lead), Ben (technical lead) and Karthik (solutions eng) to own the delivery and intake. Quick summary of the agreement for the team:
- Pilot: 3 clinical teams, ~15 active users, 8-week pilot window starting post-kickoff
- Entitlements: Dedicated inference pool (m), 50k tokens/day baseline with burst allowance
- Data: No PHI will be sent to hosted endpoints until intake is complete; we will provide a private staging option if needed
- Acceptance: agreed evaluation playbook and sample prompt set (refer to SOW sec 2.3)

Attachments: pricing_summary_tidewell.xlsx, Tidewell_Signed_SOW_062026.pdf

Immediate asks for the CS/tech intake team:
1) Propose two kickoff dates (week of 6/29 or week of 7/6) — both a stakeholder workshop and a subsequent tech sync.
2) Security intake owner and preferred channel for receiving questionnaire and evidence (pdf/Drive link).
3) Any internal constraints (IP allowlist, VPC peering, IP ranges) we should know about before tech sync.

Marissa — can you own the kickoff schedule and confirm who will lead the acceptance tracking? Ben/Karthik — please flag any pre-kick obstacles (api keys, dataset samples) and propose a pre-kick tech sync date.

Thanks team — I'll keep Ari updated as you respond.

— Mateo

- Stakeholder kickoff (90 minutes): Tue 2026-06-29 10:00–11:30 PT — review success metrics, acceptance criteria, and pilot scope.
- Technical intake (60 minutes): Thu 2026-07-01 09:00–10:00 PT — network, auth, and data scope.
- Pre-kick tech sync (30 minutes): Wed 2026-06-24 11:00–11:30 PT — internal alignment with Ben/Karthik.

Owners:
- CS Lead / Acceptance Owner: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwoodinference.com) — will own pilot success metric tracking and weekly check-ins.
- Technical Delivery Lead: Ben Carter (ben@redwoodinference.com) — will lead integration and staging.
- Solutions / Config: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com) — will handle prompts, prompts library, and model configuration.

Pre-kick items we need from Tidewell:
- Security contact and preferred method to exchange docs (pdf or Drive link).
- A sample of the prompt set (5–10 prompts) for acceptance evaluation — sanitized or synthetic if necessary.
- Network allowlist details if you want to use hosted staging (IP ranges / VPC connector).

Thanks Ari / Marissa — Ben here. Will take the technical lead. A few notes from the tech side:

1) Pre-kick tech sync (internal): Wed 2026-06-24 11:00 PT — confirm. I'll prepare a short integration checklist.
2) We need:
   - Staging API key or a service account for testing (preferably with token rotation enabled).
   - A small sample dataset (anonymized prompt/responses) to validate rate/latency assumptions.
   - Allowlist details if Tidewell expects our hosted staging to initiate callbacks — otherwise we will request a peered VPC option.
3) Risk callouts:
   - If Tidewell intends to push PHI during pilot without a private deployment, we will need an approved data-flow diagram and sign-off by our security team.
   - Large prompt context windows (>= 8k tokens) may change infra sizing; flag if you expect long transcripts.

I'll post the integration checklist to the Drive folder and upload the pre-kick tech agenda by EOD today.

Attachment references: pricing_summary_tidewell.xlsx (from Mateo)

— Ben
